$comment: Page-weight budgets for the documentation site, checked in CI by scripts/verify-page-weight.php. Recalibrated on 2026-11-05 for SIMAI Framework ui-c3015f76bcc2, whose core.js grew from 727 KB to 1.12 MB: 167 pages, median 4.28 MB, heaviest ordinary pages 5.39 MB (ru/components/surface/) and 5.24 MB (ru/project-demos/, ru/development/composition/). First calibrated on 2026-10-20 (main 57686108). Static estimate; headless Chrome loads 0.5-0.9 MB more per page (Framework chunks a script loads, icon weights picked at run time). On 2026-11-05 the English pages got their own budgets beside the Russian ones (259 pages).

/en/components/diagram-gallery/.reason: 8.31 MB: Mermaid (3.57 MB) loads once for the 22 diagrams of the English gallery.

/en/components/diagram/.reason: 7.95 MB: Mermaid (3.57 MB) renders the diagrams on the English copy of this page.

/en/components/icon/.reason: 6.16 MB: the English copy of the icon page, which draws every family, weight and fill.

/en/development/composition/.reason: 5.54 MB: the composition guide, measured over the default after the English pages were added.

/en/examples/extensions/.reason: 6.19 MB: the English copy of the example gallery, with the same components.

/ru/components/icon/.reason: 6.08 MB: the icon page draws every family, weight and fill, so it loads catalogue faces the other pages do not, and lists all 3926 icon names.
